summary.purpose: Record current review-quality calibration against curated human-review benchmarks.
summary.interpretation: Weak and Needs attention scores are product-quality gaps, not test harness failures.
summary.currentPattern: Priority fixtures now match expected broad human-review findings, design-tool fixtures generate scoped artboard/frame findings, and marker accuracy is measured by pixel overlap rather than structure alone.

knownWeaknesses: Onboarding and mobile benchmark priority ordering still need focused calibration after this pass.
Live Ollama deltas depend on a reachable local Ollama endpoint and installed model.
Marker pixel overlap is evaluated from benchmark geometry; browser screenshot pixel-diff proof remains a separate e2e concern.
acceptanceDirection: Clean-good baseline should continue to produce few findings and no high-severity findings.
Design-tool fixtures should produce artboard/frame findings without critiquing editor chrome.
Top findings should align with expected human-review priority order for calibrated fixtures.
Findings should merge symptoms into broader root-cause critique where evidence overlaps.
